requested_inventory: actual model-training methods, counts, artifacts, and logs
scope.method: Read-only inventory and arithmetic-free transcription of already-existing CSV, JSON, source, model, and log artifacts; only this evidence JSON and its Markdown digest were created.
scope.evidence_rule: A number is included only when it is present in a cited existing artifact. Current file SHA-256 values were recomputed read-only where listed.

executive_verdict.market_comparison_bottom_line: The v11 market-anchor experiments report positive retrospective delta log likelihood in several reused validation/test analyses, but ordinary full-rank model selections trail the market on test win/place hit rate and selected-event Brier. No cited result establishes pristine forward profitability; every cited deployment recommendation remains stake=0 or NO_GO.
executive_verdict.independent_confirmation_status: NOT ESTABLISHED: TEST and late-VALID blocks were already inspected/reused; fresh64 was an already-observed optional continuation; prospective target outcomes were not scored in the frozen artifacts cited here.

source_chain.reference_role: finish-order label reference; label column ord

preprocessing_integrity.fit_scope: All imputation, scaling, target encoding, correlation pruning, and reference decisions use training data only.

correlation.method: Pearson on training model features only

scaling_direct_recheck.interpretation: Binary/unit-interval columns were not forced to zero mean and unit variance. This is not a preprocessing failure; standard scaling is also not required by tree models.

strict_target_encoding.train_rule: All entries on a date are encoded before that date's outcomes update history; only strictly earlier dates contribute.
strict_target_encoding.valid_test_rule: Full training mapping only; validation and test outcomes never update the mapping.

git_dataset_comparison.reason: It is the only materialized model matrix in the comparison with zero nonnumeric, missing, and infinite feature cells plus explicit train-only |Pearson| >= 0.95 pruning to zero remaining pairs.
git_dataset_comparison.comparison_limit: Not like-for-like: Git is an interim source plus a runtime transformer; v11 is a materialized matrix. Tree pipelines may intentionally omit scaling. Pairwise Pearson pruning does not prove absence of nonlinear redundancy or multivariate collinearity.

chronology_and_leakage.market_anchor_role: q is race-normalized inverse closing win odds and enters as a fixed log(q) offset/base margin, not as an ordinary learned feature column.
known_non_pristine_evaluation_boundaries: The v11 TEST period was inspected and reused across project rounds; it is retrospective robustness evidence, not an untouched confirmation sample.
H10A fresh64 was already observed optional-continuation data and is explicitly post hoc, not pristine confirmation.
H11D, H13, H14, and H17 use a late-VALID 28-day block that was reused after H11D; later comparisons are descriptive, not independent.

H11D parsed zero TEST rows, but a pre-analysis whole-file Get-FileHash operation physically streamed bytes covering the TEST region. No TEST row was decoded or used in metrics, but strict whole-turn TEST-region physical I/O was not zero.
Closing odds define q and odds bands. They are not timestamped executable decision-time quotes.

prospective_card_audit_at_h11b_freeze.warning: This is a point-in-time H11B freeze artifact, not proof that later prospective watcher/scoring work remained unchanged.

models.method: RandomForestRegressor on normalized finish-percentile target; prediction sign inverted so lower predicted position ranks higher
XGBRanker with race qid and rank:ndcg objective using graded relevance derived from every finish order
LightGBM LambdaRank with race groups and graded full-order relevance
CatBoostRanker YetiRankPairwise with race group_id and full-order graded relevance
Three-member PyTorch RankNet ensemble trained on all unequal within-race finish-order pairs with pairwise softplus loss
PyTorch neural Plackett-Luce likelihood over every finish position; only complete strict-order training races

models: anchored conditional logit with fixed coefficient-one log(q) offset and L2 selected on validation
anchored Base Margin booster with validation-selected tree count
market_anchor_v11.ensemble: 50/50 arithmetic probability ensemble of the two saved anchors
market_anchor_v11.refit_rule: Hyperparameters selected on validation; final test models refit on train+valid.

rolling_and_residual_research.confirmation_status: retrospective rolling OOS, not pristine forward confirmation
retrospective fixed-lock rolling OOS, not pristine independent confirmation

rolling_and_residual_research.independent_validator: 28/28 PASS after validator-only deterministic CPU correction; tolerance, models, predictions, protocol, and freeze unchanged

rolling_and_residual_research.warning: Weights sum above one, implying a negative effective market exponent in the unconstrained formulation; later constrained variants were created because of this instability.

rolling_and_residual_research.interpretation: Regularization collapsed the residual correction almost entirely toward the market anchor.

probability_normalization.method: race-level score softmax after validation-only temperature fitting

rank_and_probability_metrics.metric_winner_warning: There is no universal best rank model: CatBoost leads NDCG@5, Spearman, and rank MAE; LightGBM leads ordered top-3 exact; Deep RankNet leads unordered top-3 exact; XGBoost leads top-1 hit.

ordinary_full_rank_direct_selection_test.scope: Direct win/place selection comparison on complete-order test races. Selected-event Brier improvement is model-versus-market for the same model-selected event, not the all-runner winner log-loss delta used by anchor studies.
ordinary_full_rank_direct_selection_test.conclusion: Every full-rank model and the ensemble trails the market selection hit rate for both win and place, and every selected-event Brier improvement is negative.

v11_market_anchor_delta_log_likelihood.definition: delta_ll_per_race = market winner NLL per race - model winner NLL per race; positive favors the model.
v11_market_anchor_delta_log_likelihood.warning: Positive reused-TEST delta LL is evidence of retrospective probability improvement, not proof of executable profit or independent confirmation.

market_favorite_baseline_test_roi.definition: One market-favorite/market combination per covered race using final values; this is a market baseline, not a deployed strategy.
market_favorite_baseline_test_roi.complex_market_probability_limit: For combination bets, the model-versus-market event probability in related analyses is q-derived proxy rather than an observed combination-pool probability. Official dividends identify settlement only for covered races.

rolling_probability_and_place_results.source_timing_caveat: Deployment remains blocked until clinic_30d source definition and pre-race availability are independently mapped.

honest_limits: No new model fit, backtest, web search, prospective score, or outcome settlement was performed for this inventory.
The evidence supports that the cited training jobs actually produced and reloaded model artifacts; it does not make reused historical test periods independent.

The current data matrix is finite, numeric, chronologically split, and correlation-pruned under the recorded Pearson rule, but this does not prove absence of nonlinear redundancy or every possible domain-time leakage.
Closing odds are used for market q and several odds-band analyses; decision-time availability, slippage, and pool impact remain unresolved.
Official final dividends already reflect pool deductions; no evidence here supports charging the 20%/27% takeout a second time.
No cited study establishes positive absolute ROI with a 95% interval wholly above zero on a pristine forward sample.
The project evidence is consistent with small market-relative probability signal in some anchored/rolling specifications, but not with a deployable, independently confirmed profitable system.
